assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: landscape illustration for an AI/ML engineer's project portfolio.
Primary request: a charming, polished skeuomorphic miniature system architecture for a healthcare machine-learning system. Use tangible 3D objects rather than rectangular diagram boxes.
Composition: wide 3:2 canvas, warm ivory background, generous margins, coherent isometric perspective. On the left a small stack of clinical record folders, a medical clipboard and a few structured-data cards. In the center-right a secure HPC cluster represented by two small beautifully detailed server cabinets and a chip/model assembly, with neat colored data beads/cables connecting records to the compute cluster. Near the servers, a model-evaluation workstation with a simple nonnumeric chart and a small stack of output records. Group by physical proximity and a subtle floor shadow, not enclosed panels. The image should read as connected data sources, secure compute, and prediction/evaluation services.
Style: tactile matte resin and soft ceramic miniature objects, subtle realistic material highlights and ambient occlusion, gentle cute proportions, professional editorial technical illustration, highly legible silhouettes. Dusty blue, sage green, lavender, peach accents. Soft studio lighting, light shadows, no dark areas.
Text: only three short English labels in neat dark blue type: "Clinical evidence", "Secure HPC", "Risk & evaluation". No other text.
Constraints: no rectangular module boxes, no flowchart, no numbered steps, no floating dashboards, no fake performance numbers, no logos, no watermark, no robots or characters. This is an explanatory architecture illustration, not a photograph of an actual deployed machine. Fill most of the canvas without cropping any objects.
